_doc: Labeled near-duplicate set built from REAL Mercan campaign copy patterns (Panama QIP / Greece Golden Visa immigration ads). Ground-truth `labeled_dup_pairs` are the human-judged near-duplicate headline pairs (i<j, ascending). Story 16.4 tunes ENGINE.near_dup_threshold against this set before P2 exit (Risk R1) and records precision/recall in the feature-log. Paraphrase-only duplicates (different words, same idea) are deliberately NOT labeled dup — token similarity cannot catch them (R1 accepted ceiling; an LLM scorer can be added behind the same flag shape later).
